# FLX-3603: a consumers asOf is not a date

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

asOf is the date that CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and NOW() read as, so a rate never depends on the day it runs. It is a full calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, as a string.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3603
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
